content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: North Macedonia accession to the agreement on government procurement & CPV code amendments
Overview

content_blocks.text: This PPN applies to all contracting authorities, as defined by the UK regulations. This includes all central government departments, their executive agencies, non-departmental public bodies and other public sector organisations including utilities (collectively referred to as ‘in-scope organisations’).
heading_path: North Macedonia accession to the agreement on government procurement & CPV code amendments
Overview

content_blocks.text: This PPN sets out requirements for in-scope organisation following North Macedonia’s accession to the World Trade Organisation’s (WTO) Agreement on Government Procurement (GPA).
heading_path: North Macedonia accession to the agreement on government procurement & CPV code amendments
Overview

content_blocks.text: The PPN also sets out amendments to two Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV) codes relating to:

Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: In-scope organisations must comply with the principles of non-discrimination and equal treatment in relation to suppliers from North Macedonia throughout the procurement process.
